stable.notes: The default character now animates in every state. Jedi Miles Windu ships with ten animated states and 74 frames — idle, patrol, waiting, running, success, error, attention, duel, trio, and swarm — so the pet moves on a fresh install with no sprite pack to add. A pack's own animated duel, trio, or swarm strip takes precedence over the stitched escalation ladder, so three and five sessions play their own choreography. Character size remains a separate 100-300% dial. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
